body: FBI Houston Spokesperson Connor Hagen tells TMZ ... 6 people were arrested by the FBI and their partner agencies this morning in Louisiana and Texas ... including the rappers. No word yet on the charges Ben10, OG 3Three, and the other 4 people are facing. The FBI is referring all questions about specific charges to the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Southern District of Texas.
